subtopics.title: Average as equal sharing
subtopics.zero: Average is the value each member would have if the total were shared equally.

examples.question: Five consecutive integers have average 24
solution: middle of equally spaced set is average

subtopics.shortcut: For equally spaced values, average is the middle value.
subtopics.traps: Do not average averages unless group sizes are equal.

subtopics.title: Combined and replacement average
subtopics.zero: Always convert averages back to totals before combining groups or replacing members.
subtopics.shortcut: For replacement, track the total change only.
subtopics.traps: (60+70)/2 is wrong when group sizes differ.
